### 1. Test files and assertion groups

**`tests/run-all.js`** — discovers every `tests/*.test.js`, runs them in criterion order 1–8, prints per-file and total summaries, exits 1 on any failure.

**`tests/_load.js`** — shared Node loader (see §2).

**`tests/syntax.test.js`** — criterion 1
- **Parse check** — every `.js` file under repo root, `src/`, and `tests/` compiles with `vm.Script` (skips `node_modules` and `.claude/`); failure names the file and parse error.
- **ES5-safe ban** — every app file under root + `src/` except `sw.js` and `tests/` is scanned (comments/strings stripped) for a standalone `let `/`const ` declaration, `=>`, or backtick template literal; reports file and line.

**`tests/curriculum.test.js`** — criterion 2
- **Modules loaded** — `HRL_CURRICULUM`, `HRL_SVG`, `HRL_GLOSSARY.bySlug`, `HRL_INTERACTIVE.names` exist.
- **Tiers** — exactly 6; keys `rookie, sandlot, diamond, select, elite, promind` in order 1–6.
- **Chapters** — exactly 24; ids `ch01`–`ch24`; `order` 1..24 with no gaps/duplicates; every `chapter.tier` resolves and each tier has exactly 4; `prev`/`next` is one chain (`ch01.prev === null`, `ch24.next === null`).
- **Sections** — every `type` is one of the ten known types; every `section.svg` is a real `HRL_SVG` builder and calling it with `opts` returns a string containing `<svg`; every `section.widget` is in `HRL_INTERACTIVE.names()`; every `terms` slug resolves in `HRL_GLOSSARY`.
- **Per-chapter shape** — ≥8 sections, ≥2 `diagram`, ≥1 `interactive`, 3–5 objectives, 6–8 `quizIds`, last section `keypoints`; no empty title/subtitle/objective; every interactive `opts` has a non-empty `cases`/`items`/`parts`/`pairs`/`positions`/`frames`/`steps` array.

**`tests/questions.test.js`** — criterion 3
- **Bank size** — ≥288 questions.
- **Ids and cross-references** — unique `/^q\d{4}$/`; every `chapter` resolves and the id’s chapter digits match; every `tier` matches its chapter.
- **Fields** — topic is one of the twelve; difficulty integer 1–10; type is `mc|tf|scenario|hotspot|order`.
- **Answers by type** — mc/tf/scenario choices ≥2 unique strings with a valid `answer` index; tf choices are exactly `['True','False']`; hotspot `targets` non-empty and every target / `diagram.opts.hotspots` id is in the `HRL_SVG` vocabulary; order `items` 3–6 distinct; every `explain` ≥20 characters.
- **Distribution** — ≥12 per chapter, ≥45 per tier, ≥15 per topic; every chapter `quizIds` exists in the bank.
- **Answer-index balance** — across 4-choice `mc` questions, no index holds more than 45% of correct answers.

**`tests/quiz.test.js`** — criterion 4
- **`shuffleQuestion` property, 200 runs** — for 4–5 choice questions, `result.choices[result.answer] === input.choices[input.answer]`, multiset unchanged, input not mutated.
- **`shuffleArray`** — preserves the multiset, does not mutate.
- **`isCorrect`** — all five types, including an `order` submission with the right elements in the wrong sequence.
- **`scoreQuiz`** — exact percentages; exactly 75% passes; 74% fails; 0 and 100 edges.
- **`nextBox`** — correct promotes, caps at 5; wrong resets to 1 from every box.
- **`dueDateFor`** — boxes 1–5 → `now + [1,3,7,16,35] * 86400000`.

**`tests/placement.test.js`** — criterion 5
- **`nextDifficulty`** — clamps at 1 and 10 from both directions.
- **`theta`** — 0 with no correct answers; otherwise mean of the hardest three correct.
- **`recommendTier`** — integer 1..6 over the full `theta × selfTier × role` grid; `role === 'coach'` never below 3.
- **`selfReportTier`** — 1..6 for every combination of `SELF_REPORT` options.
- **Skip** — skipped placement yields tier 1.

**`tests/iq.test.js`** — criterion 6
- **`computeBbiq`** — 40..160 inclusive for empty, all-correct, all-wrong, mixed, and all-zero difficulty (no `NaN`, no throw); all-wrong is exactly 40; all-correct is exactly 160.
- **`bandFor`** — 69 Rookie, 70/89 Sandlot, 90/109 Diamond, 110/124 Select, 125/139 Elite, 140/160 Pro Mind.
- **`nextDifficulty`** — clamps at 1 and 10.
- **`pickQuestion`** — never returns an already-used id; prefers unused topics until 8 distinct topics; `null` on an exhausted pool; simulated 20-question run over the real bank yields 20 distinct questions covering ≥8 topics.

**`tests/progress.test.js`** — criterion 7
- **`mergeState` rules** — `bestScore` max; `attempts` summed; `completed` sticky-true; `completedAt` earlier wins; badges set union; review union by `qid` with later `dueAt` and `misses` max; `iq.attempts` concatenated and deduped by `takenAt`; `iq.best` higher wins; `streak.longest` max; placement later `takenAt` wins; settings incoming wins per key; neither argument is mutated.
- **`importPayload` / `importText`** — `{ ok: false }` with a non-empty message and no throw for `null`, `undefined`, `'not json'`, `[]`, `{}`, `{ app: 'something-else', data: {} }`, and a far-future `dataVersion`; `importText` same for malformed JSON.
- **Leitner helpers** — `BOX_INTERVALS` and `addMiss`/`recordReview` produce 1/3/7/16/35 day dues.
- **Export** — `exportFilename` is `homerun-learn-progress-YYYY-MM-DD.json` for a fixed date; `exportPayload` has `app`, `appVersion`, `dataVersion`, `exportedAt`, `data`.

## 2. Module loading

`tests/_load.js` sets `global.window = global` (no `document`, so DOM-gated code stays inert), then `require`s in `index.html` order:

`version.js` → `versionCompat.js` → glossary → curriculum skeleton + t1…t6 → questions skeleton + t1…t6 → `svg.js` → `progress.js` → `interactive.js` → `quiz.js` → `iq.js` → `placement.js`

Plain `require` is used for every module that has the `var root = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window : this` shim.

**`interactive.js` is the only vm-fallback candidate.** It assigns `window.HRL_INTERACTIVE` and has no `module.exports`. The loader `require`s it first; if that throws, or if `names` is missing, it `vm.runInThisContext`s the file. Widget `mount` functions touch `document` only when called, so headless load should succeed via `require`.

The return object is the eight requested namespaces **plus `HRL_INTERACTIVE`**, which the curriculum tests need.

## 4. API mismatches (all worked around; worth a look)

| Brief vs reality | Resolution |
|---|---|
| `tests/versionCompat.test.js` “already present” | It was not. Written from the practice-app test, with `HRP_` → `HRL_`. Practice-plan / `normalizePracticePlan` tests dropped (`practice.js` does not exist). |
| Ten section types not named | Used the ten `learn.js` actually renders: `prose`, `diagram`, `keypoints`, `interactive`, `example`, `coachnote`, `divisionnote`, `terms`, `compare`, `steps`. Spec listed eight; curriculum also uses `compare` and `steps`. |
| `HRL_SVG` “twelve builders” | Real export also has `tierHero`. Tests accept any function on `HRL_SVG`. |
| `interactive.js` “Browser-only”, no `module.exports` | Loaded via `window` shim + optional `vm` fallback. |
| `version.js` / `changelog.js` / `feedback.js` assign `window.HRL_*` with no shim | Same `global.window = global` trick. |
| Terms as `section.terms` | Real shape is `type: 'terms'` + `items: [slug, …]`. Tests read `items` (and `terms` if present). |
| Skipped placement “yields tier 1” | `skip()` does not return a value; it writes `SKIP_TIER` (1) through `HRL_PROGRESS.setPlacement`. Asserted against that record. |
| `importPayload('not json')` | A string is rejected as “not an object”, not as JSON parse failure. Same `{ ok: false, message }` contract. `importText` is what parses JSON. |
| `HRL_INTERACTIVE` not in the requested `_load` return | Added anyway; curriculum tests need `names()`. |
| Test files `process.exit(1)` vs `run-all.js` `require` | Files record into `global.__HRL_TEST_RUNNER` when the runner is present, and only `process.exit` when run directly. |
